Constants.Name: Core_Delta.core_delta_version
Constants.Description: Change

Constants.Name: CommunityCommons.MergeMultiplePdfs_MaxAtOnce
Constants.Description:
Restricted to 10 files at once for Mendix Cloud v4 compatibility. If you need to merge more than 10 files increase the number here. Setting the value to <=0 means unlimited.

Note: We very strongly recommend to not increase the number for applications running in Mendix Cloud v4.

Constants.Name: DocumentGeneration.AsyncTimeoutInSeconds
Constants.Description: Timeout in seconds for an asynchronous request; determines how long a document is allowed to be queued by the Cloud service

Constants.Name: DocumentGeneration.CustomChromePath
Constants.Description: Path to Chrome or Chromium executable, for example: C:/Program Files/Google/Chrome/Application/Chrome.exe

Constants.Name: DocumentGeneration.CustomNodePath
Constants.Description: Path to Node.js executable, for example: C:/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe

Constants.Name: DocumentGeneration.OverrideServiceType
Constants.Description: Overrides the service type to use. The applicable values are: Local, Cloud or empty (default). When empty, the module will determine the service type based on the operating system.

Constants.Name: DocumentGeneration.SyncTimeoutInSeconds
Constants.Description: Timeout in seconds for a synchronous request to wait for the result

Constants.Name: DocumentGeneration.TokenLifetimeInSeconds
Constants.Description:
Security token lifetime in seconds. The security token is used to secure and validate document requests from the local and/or cloud service.

Default value: 1800 (30 minutes)

Constants.Name: Encryption.EncryptionKey
Constants.Description:
This key will be used to encrypt and decrypt values.
The length of this key must be 32 characters.

Constants.Name: Encryption.EncryptionPrefix
Constants.Description:
Prefix for stored encrypted values.
This value is used to determine whether the value has been already encrypted.
The prefix must be either {AES}, {AES2} or {AES3}.
Encryption is only supported if the prefix is {AES3}.
It is not recommended to change this value.

Constants.Name: Encryption.LegacyEncryptionKey
Constants.Description:
This key will be used to decrypt values that are encrypted with legacy algorithms.
The length of this key must be 16 characters.

Constants.Name: Encryption.LogNode
Constants.Description: Node which appears in log messages for this module.

Constants.Name: SAML20.BindingURI_Redirect
Constants.Description:
If you encounter the error (most likely you are using Mac OSX and a Safari browser):
“MSIS7046: The SAML protocol parameter ‘RelayState’ was not found or not valid.”

Setting this Boolean to true might help you resolve the issue. By default we favour the Post binding as the maximum size exceeds that of a Redirect binding due to it using cookies en post information instead of URL parameters (redirect). The size can be a factor when using encryption.

Constants.Name: SAML20.DefaultLoginPage
Constants.Description:
You could define another login page here, for example when you configured the index.html page to redirect to '/SSO/'

This page allows the user to open a default Mendix login page so he can access the application with his regular credentials. The page opened from this location should contain a Mendix login page.

If you leave this constant empty the user will not get a button to open the default login page in case the SSO action fails.
Or you could specify a page starting without any slashes, such as:   login.html

Constants.Name: SAML20.DefaultLogoutPage
Constants.Description:
It is recommended to remove the sign out button, but if you choose to keep the sign out button the user will be redirected to a page. 

After signing out the user will be redirected to this location.

Constants.Name: SAML20.DisableDecoding_Deeplink_URL
Constants.Description:
It will disable the decoding of the deep link redirect URL, and is only effective if the deep link URL is not encoded when using the SSO/login endpoint.
Note:
We recommend not changing the value unless absolutely necessary.

Constants.Name: SAML20.SSOLandingPage
Constants.Description:
You could define another landing page here, for example:
When you would like to redirect to '/SSO/' directly from your index.html page by adding '<meta http-equiv="refresh" content="0;URL=/SSO/" />', you don't want to end up on 'index.html' again.  
By renaming this constant to '/index3.html', you'll land on index3 instead of index.
Don't forget to add a 'index3.html' to your theme in this case! (You can copy the contents from index.html to index3.html)

ScheduledEvents.Name: DocumentGeneration.SE_AccessToken_Refresh
ScheduledEvents.Description: This scheduled event refreshes the access token that is used to secure access to the Document Generation Cloud service. If your app is running in the Mendix cloud, this scheduled event needs to be enabled.

ScheduledEvents.Name: DocumentGeneration.SE_DocumentRequest_Cleanup
ScheduledEvents.Description: This scheduled event removes expired DocumentRequest objects after a configured offset in days (using constant @DocumentGeneration.RequestCleanupOffsetInDays, the default value is 7 days).

ScheduledEvents.Name: SAML20.SE_LogCleanUp
ScheduledEvents.Description: This action will cleanup the loglines. The logs entries will be archived for the amount of days specified in the configuration, the log entries that reached the limit will be deleted.

ScheduledEvents.Name: SAML20.SE_SynchronizeIdPMetadata
ScheduledEvents.Description: This action synchronises the Idendity Provider metadata.
